paragraphs.text: Adam Lee is a creative Magic designer for Wizards of the Coast . Adam has been a flavor writer for Magic since Coldsnap , was heavily involved with names and flavor text for Rise of the Eldrazi (among other things), and worked with Magic R&D for the Innistrad block . As representative from the creative team, he was part of several design teams.
Lee worked for Wizards of the Coast between April 2010 and November 2021. In 2024, he created The Magic: The Gathering Oracle Deck .
